Account.title: Account
Account.description: A hierarchical chart-of-accounts entry conforming to the RGS (Referentie Grootboek Schema) standard for Dutch bookkeeping.

accountNumber.description: RGS-style account code (e.g. '1000', '4100'). Unique within an administration.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for this account's base currency.

parentAccountNumber.description: FK to the parent Account.accountNumber for hierarchy navigation.

isClosingAccount.description: Designates this as the administration's single closing account for period-end equity absorption.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this account. Scopes uniqueness of accountNumber.

lifecycleState.description: Current lifecycle state of the account.

description.description: Operator-authored free-text description of the account.

vatApplicable.description: Whether VAT/BTW applies to transactions posted to this account.

active.label: Active
active.description: Fully usable for new GL postings.

blocked.label: Blocked
blocked.description: Readable and referenceable by existing postings, but rejected as the target of new GL lines.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Historical only — no new postings, no edits; remains queryable.

block.label: Block account
block.description: Prevent new postings against this account.

unblock.label: Unblock account
unblock.description: Re-enable new postings against this account.

archiveFromActive.label: Archive account
archiveFromActive.description: Move to historical archive. Requires zero open balance.

archiveFromBlocked.label: Archive account
archiveFromBlocked.description: Move to historical archive from blocked state. Requires zero open balance.

InnovatieboxElection.title: Innovatiebox Election
InnovatieboxElection.description: Per-fiscal-year innovatiebox route election per Wet Vpb art. 12b/12bg. Records whether the forfaitair (art. 12bg) or afpelmethode (art. 12b) route applies for a given administration and fiscal year. Exactly one election per (administrationId, fiscalYear) is permitted.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this election.

fiscalYear.description: The fiscal year for which this route election applies.

route.description: Elected innovatiebox route. forfaitair: 25% of operating profit capped at EUR 25 000 (Wet Vpb art. 12bg). afpelmethode: explicit per-IP-asset profit attribution (Wet Vpb art. 12b).

applicableTariff.description: Innovatiebox tariff in effect for the fiscal year. Default 0.09 (9%) per Wet Vpb art. 12b 2026; populated from innovatiebox-tariefen seed.

forfaitairCapBedrag.description: Statutory cap on innovation-attributed profit under the forfaitair route per Wet Vpb art. 12bg. Default EUR 25 000.

forfaitairPercentage.description: Percentage of operating profit attributed to innovation under the forfaitair route per Wet Vpb art. 12bg. Default 0.25 (25%).

operatingProfit.description: Operating profit for the fiscal year in euros. Required for forfaitair calculation. Source: Vpb-balans.

notes.description: Optional bookkeeper notes on the election.
notes.example: Elected forfaitair; operating profit confirmed at EUR 200k.

uniqueElectionPerFiscalYear.description: Exactly one InnovatieboxElection per (administrationId, fiscalYear). Enforces mutual exclusion of the two innovatiebox routes per fiscal year per Wet Vpb art. 12b/12bg.

forfaitairInnovationProfit.description: Innovation-attributed profit under the forfaitair route: min(forfaitairPercentage x operatingProfit, forfaitairCapBedrag). Only valid when route = forfaitair.

capApplied.description: True when the forfaitair cap binds (25% of operating profit exceeds the statutory EUR 25 000 cap). Triggers an audit-trail-immutable cap-application event.

innovatieboxAdministratie.description: Per-year innovatiebox-administratie summary. Branches on the elected route: forfaitair applies min(forfaitairPercentage x operatingProfit, forfaitairCapBedrag) per REQ-IBA-002; afpelmethode sums WinstToerekening.toegerekendeWinst x applicableTariff per IP asset per REQ-IBA-003.

afpelmethode.description: At least one IPAssetValuation is required when route = afpelmethode.

onRouteElection.message: Innovatiebox route '{{route}}' elected for fiscal year {{fiscalYear}} (administration {{administrationId}})
onRouteElection.description: Writes a route-election event to audit-trail-immutable on election creation.

onRouteChange.message: Innovatiebox route changed to '{{route}}' for fiscal year {{fiscalYear}} (administration {{administrationId}})
onRouteChange.description: Writes a route-change event to audit-trail-immutable when the route field is updated.

onCapApplication.message: Forfaitair cap applied for fiscal year {{fiscalYear}}: innovation profit capped at {{forfaitairCapBedrag}} EUR (operating profit: {{operatingProfit}} EUR)
onCapApplication.description: Writes a cap-application event to audit-trail-immutable when the forfaitair cap binds.

onTariffApplication.message: Innovatiebox tariff {{applicableTariff}} applied for fiscal year {{fiscalYear}} (route: {{route}}, administration: {{administrationId}})
onTariffApplication.description: Writes a tariff-application event to audit-trail-immutable when the tariff is applied in aggregation.

IPAssetValuation.title: IP Asset Valuation
IPAssetValuation.description: Immaterieel activum eligible for the innovatiebox under the afpelmethode (Wet Vpb art. 12b). Declares the asset type, capitalised valuation, and applicable tariff for winsttoerekening. Only used when InnovatieboxElection.route = afpelmethode.

assetNaam.description: Human-readable name of the IP asset.

assetType.description: Type of qualifying IP asset per Wet Vpb art. 12ba.

wbsoVerklaringNummer.description: FK to the WBSO S&O-verklaring from the wbso-sno-administratie capability. Required when assetType = s-en-o-certificaat.

octrooiNummer.description: Patent registration number. Required when assetType = octrooi.

valuationBedrag.description: Capitalised valuation of the IP asset in euros.

valuationDate.description: Effective date of the asset valuation.

applicableTariff.description: Innovatiebox tariff in effect at valuationDate. Default 0.09 (9%) per Wet Vpb art. 12b 2026; populated from innovatiebox-tariefen seed.

vpbBalansLinkId.description: FK to VpbBalansLink linking this IP asset to the Vpb-balans balance sheet entry (REQ-VPB-002).

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this IP asset. Must match the InnovatieboxElection.administrationId.

fiscalYear.description: Fiscal year this asset valuation applies to.

winstToerekeninge.description: All winsttoerekening entries attributing profit to this IP asset.

WinstToerekening.title: Winsttoerekening
WinstToerekening.description: Per-period mapping of operating profit to one or more IP assets via a configurable verdeelsleutel (Wet Vpb art. 12b, afpelmethode only). MUST NOT be populated when InnovatieboxElection.route = forfaitair.

ipAssetId.description: FK to the IPAssetValuation this profit toerekening belongs to.

periodId.description: FK to the FiscalPeriod this toerekening covers.

toegerekendeWinst.description: Profit attributed to the IP asset in euros for this period.

verdeelsleutel.description: Method used to attribute operating profit to the IP asset.

parameters.description: Verdeelsleutel-specific calculation parameters. For omzet-aandeel: {omzetAandeel: 0.30}. For r-en-d-uren: {rdUren: 450, totalUren: 1200}. For custom-formula: {formula: '...'}.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this winsttoerekening.

vpbImpact.description: Vpb impact for this period's attributed profit at the applicable innovatiebox tariff. Joins IPAssetValuation to resolve applicableTariff.

ipAsset.description: The IP asset this profit toerekening is attributed to.
